title: TapHound context refresh --json Output
description: Reference shape for the JSON result of `context refresh --json`. Core recomputes evidence hashes, backfills semanticSha256, rehashes formatting-only changes, repairs drifted hashes, and prunes deleted-file entries. The status field tells the agent whether to re-analyze source.

status.description: refreshed: at least one scope was written. unchanged: no hashes needed repair. blocked: one or more scopes could not be auto-refreshed.

indexHash.description: SHA-256 of the root index file bytes after refresh.

acceptedSourceChanges.description: Whether --accept-source-changes was passed and semantic edits were rehashed.

scopes.description: One entry per module (scope=module) plus one for the root index (scope=index).

blocked.description: Scopes that could not be auto-refreshed. Each block carries a resolution the agent must act on.

exitCode.description: 0 when status is refreshed or unchanged. 1 when status is blocked.

id.description: Module ID for scope=module, or "index" for scope=index.

contextPath.description: Project-relative path to the shard or index file.

written.description: Whether the file was actually written (hashes changed).

semanticBackfilled.description: Number of evidence entries where semanticSha256 was missing and has been added.

formattingRehashed.description: Number of evidence entries whose full hash changed but semantic hash did not (formatting-only edit, rehashed automatically).

semanticChanged.description: Project-relative paths whose semantic hash changed. Requires --accept-source-changes to rehash; otherwise blocked.

unresolved.description: Project-relative paths that could not be read (deleted or moved). Requires --prune-deleted to drop; otherwise blocked.

pruned.description: Number of evidence entries pruned via --prune-deleted.

inventoryChanged.description: Whether the module's inventory pathSetSha256 changed (files added or removed). Always blocks auto-refresh; requires reanalysis.

code.description: EVIDENCE_UNRESOLVED: file missing. EVIDENCE_SEMANTIC_CHANGED: source semantics changed. MODULE_INVENTORY_CHANGED: files added or removed.

resolution.description: Action the agent must take: pruneDeleted → refresh --prune-deleted. acceptSourceChanges → refresh --accept-source-changes. reanalyze → re-scan source and regenerate the shard.
